name: aesthetic-dna
description: 设计审美内核：网页界面、落地页、海报 logo、生图提示词、广告片与 MV 导演拍法的高级感判断，以及土不土、像不像山寨的防土规则。 Aesthetic judgment for visual work: premium look, kitsch check for contested elements by style, web taste rules, cinematic ad and music-video direction, and pre-delivery checks. Use it with design-workflow when building a site; use it alone to judge whether a poster, page or prompt looks cheap.
author: Artemis
